title: Remediation: remove hot-path debug file writes and full-response JSON logging
description: Every GET /api/crud request unconditionally serializes the full response (ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) at get.ps1:79 via Write-FormattedLog -tag 'debug' — this runs on the normal request path regardless of Podex.Debug. Separately, when Podex.Debug is on (the shipped default), get.ps1:80-82 writes a Get.json artifact into the source tree via New-Item -Path $PSScriptRoot -Force. Together these put large-object serialization (always-on) and synchronous disk I/O (Debug-gated) on the request hot path and litter the repo. Both the always-on serialization and the per-request disk writes into the source tree must be removed or gated behind an explicit non-default flag.
spec:
1. Verify api/crud/get.ps1:80-82 no longer writes $($WebEvent.Method).json into $PSScriptRoot on each request (remove the write, or redirect it to a dedicated, git-ignored logs directory guarded by an explicit non-default flag).
2. Verify the unconditional full-response serialization at get.ps1:79 (Write-FormattedLog -tag 'debug' with ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) is removed or gated so it does not run on the normal request path.
3. Verify a GET /api/crud request with Podex.Debug enabled produces no new file under api/crud/ and no Get.json in the source tree.
4. Verify the endpoint's functional response (rows, tags, paging fields, status codes) is unchanged after removing the debug writes.

The route no longer serializes the full response on the hot path and writes no artifact into the source tree under any config. Response object and all response-writing branches (200/204/400/500, rows/tags/paging fields) untouched; `npm test` 50/0.
